title: A clearer dashboard
lede: A compact dashboard header, followed by booking titles you can read in full.

stats.n: Counted in the matched standard-size fixture captures. Rows grow to show their content.
Busy fixture at standard text size. Card edge: y=1119 → 830 px, divided by the 3× capture scale.

sections.heading: Readable booking rows
sections.note: The baseline includes the first header cleanup. Both builds use the same hour-anchored fixture data, device, appearance, text size, and top scroll position. CSS shows matching queue regions and excludes the status-bar clock.

pairs.title: Standard text: full identity before timing
pairs.beforeCap: Five of six titles lose identifying words to a trailing time column.
pairs.afterCap: All six titles are complete. Timing and location are directly underneath.

pairs.title: Accessibility Large: the content can grow
pairs.beforeCap: Titles and pickup context truncate even as text grows.
pairs.afterCap: Titles, times, and pickup context wrap. Fewer rows fit, but each visible row can be read.

sections.heading: Greeting and summary
sections.note: Same iPhone 16 Pro, fixture identity and counts, text size, and top scroll position. Views below are clipped in CSS to the changed header region; originals remain unmodified. Time-relative booking rows and status-bar clocks are excluded.

pairs.title: Upcoming work takes priority
pairs.beforeCap: Large split greeting, stacked metrics, and explanatory subtitle.
pairs.afterCap: Wrapping greeting, two summary columns, and a concise Next Up heading.

changes.h: Booking identity gets the width it needs
changes.was: A single-line title competed with the trailing due time.
changes.now: The title wraps across the content column, followed by status-colored timing and supporting context. Row actions and urgency order are preserved.

changes.was: The name occupied a separate red line at 30 pt.
changes.now: Greeting and name share wrapping 24 pt Gotham Bold text; urgency owns the strong color.

changes.was: Each count occupied a full-width row.
changes.now: Two columns at standard text sizes, one at accessibility sizes. Existing status colors, labels, counts, and tap destinations remain.

changes.was: Next Up repeated the list contents in an explanatory sentence.
changes.now: The heading lets the actual work describe the section.
